terms.simple_def: The job of keeping software systems running reliably.

translations.es: Ingeniería de fiabilidad: mantener los sistemas funcionando.

terms.simple_def: A system that runs and manages many containers across many computers.

translations.es: Sistema que ejecuta y gestiona contenedores en muchas máquinas.

terms.simple_def: A package holding an app and everything it needs to run.
A group of computers that work together as one system.
The smallest unit Kubernetes runs: one or more containers together.
A stable network address for a group of pods.
A pod keeps crashing, so Kubernetes waits longer before each restart.
The first real reason a problem happened.
Being the person who must respond if systems break.
A database built for fast search across large amounts of text.
Finding documents that contain the exact words you typed.
Search that combines exact word matching with matching by meaning.
An AI looks up relevant documents first, then writes its answer.

translations.es: La IA busca documentos relevantes antes de responder.

terms.simple_def: A list of numbers that captures the meaning of text.

translations.es: Lista de números que representa el significado de un texto.

terms.simple_def: A list of numbers a computer can compare with other lists.
A formula that scores how well a document matches your words.

translations.es: Fórmula que puntúa cuánto coincide un documento con tus palabras.

terms.simple_def: A way to merge several ranked result lists into one.

translations.es: Método para combinar varias listas de resultados en una.

terms.simple_def: A collection of documents an AI or person can look things up in.
